seedDetection.rule: the largest detection at sea (GSHHG: centre offshore, at most 10% of it on land) whose outline never runs straight along the pixel grid for 1.2 km or more -- an edge that straight is the model's box, not a slick's edge -- and that covers at least 0.05 km2

forcingNote: ERA5 10 m wind and CMEMS hourly surface currents (cmems_mod_glo_phy_anfc_0.083deg_PT1H-m, 1/12 deg). Each member's wind is shifted in time by up to 3 h either way (ISSUES X9).
seeding: 200 parcels per member, spread uniformly over the seed detection's polygon; the same positions for every member
forwardForcingNote: For the 72 h after the pass: ERA5 10 m wind and CMEMS hourly surface currents (cmems_mod_glo_phy_anfc_0.083deg_PT1H-m, 1/12 deg). Each member's wind is shifted in time by up to 3 h either way (ISSUES X9). Parcels that reach the coast strand (OpenDrift coastline_action 'stranding').

age.explanation: spread grew from the observation onwards and never re-focused; diffusion is irreversible, so no age can be read from convergence alone. This is physics, not a failure
